purpose: Cover US-17404 (D3 bites): the three D3 bite checks shapes:templateMarkers, shapes:entityJoin and shapes:pathsResolve each have pass, fail, notApplicable, id and why strings; drafts are included in templateMarkers; the readiness CLI --check shapes exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure and 0 when acked at the current hash; ackable() is exactly D3, D5, D6; --ack on D1, D2, D4, D7 or D8 exits 2 unchanged.
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 5: D3 bite checks, ackable, --check exit 4 policy

testCases.description: A recordShape with fields: and an httpRoute with method, path, request, response and errors each pass shapes:templateMarkers.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4131, AC-17404-1): recordShape+fields and httpRoute+5 markers each pass shapes:templateMarkers

testCases.description: An httpRoute description missing errors fails shapes:templateMarkers with id <tacId>:<name> and why 'missing marker errors'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4131, AC-17404-2): httpRoute missing errors fails templateMarkers with <tacId>:<name> and "missing marker errors"

testCases.description: Every coreEntity named by exactly one recordShape passes shapes:entityJoin; one named twice fails TAD.entity:<name> with '2 record shapes'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4131, AC-17404-3): entityJoin passes 1:1 and fails TAD.entity:<name> with "2 record shapes" when twice

testCases.description: An interface description naming a path present in resolvedPaths passes shapes:pathsResolve; a missing path on an interface marked authoredAt: D3 in the description also passes.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4131, AC-17404-4): pathsResolve passes a resolved path and passes a missing path when authoredAt D3 is in the description

testCases.description: rcf define readiness --check shapes exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure and 0 when the freeze record acknowledges define.shapes at the current tree hash.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17404-5 --check shapes exits 4 unacked and 0 acked at current hash

testCases.description: rcf define freeze --ack <gate> --reason <text> on D1, D2, D4, D7 or D8 exits 2 unchanged from 0.29.0.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/freeze.test.js::freeze cli: AC-17404-6 --ack on D1, D2, D4, D7 or D8 exits 2 unchanged

testCases.description: ackable(stage) returns true for D3, D5 and D6 and false for D1, D2, D4, D7 and D8.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4131): ackable(stage) is exactly D3, D5 and D6; stagePolicy keeps saying blocking

testCases.description: A [draft] recordShape without fields: fails shapes:templateMarkers exactly as a settled one; this completes AC-18801-4 from PR 3.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (REQ-188, AC-18801-4): draft recordShape without fields fails templateMarkers (lifted by PR 5 ADR-4131)

testCases.description: A D3 scope narrowed so no TAC and no shaped REQ is in scope but a coreEntity has no record shape anywhere tree-wide still fails shapes:entityJoin (stage state failing, not notApplicable) via the ADR-4138 helper.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (R5, AC-17404-7): entityJoin runs tree-wide under narrowed D3 scope

testCases.description: extractInterfacePathTokens treats Dockerfile, Makefile, LICENSE, Procfile, Containerfile, Justfile, Rakefile, Gemfile and CODEOWNERS as candidate tokens; shapes:pathsResolve fails a path: Dockerfile when not in resolvedPaths and passes when resolved. The exported BARE_PATH_WHITELIST drives both.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (R6, AC-17404-8): bare path whitelist is checked by pathsResolve

testCases.description: treeWideFailureEnvelope returns null when every tree-wide check passes under a scope-empty stage; on D3 with a failing tree-wide check and a freeze.gates ack at the currentTreeHash it folds through foldState to state 'acknowledged'; on D2 (blocking) with a failing tree-wide check it stays 'failing'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 292 follow-up, AC-17404-9): treeWideFailureEnvelope helper semantics
